profile.headline: Research Software Engineer at National Center for Ecological Analysis and Synthesis (NCEAS)
profile.summary: I use scientific data processing and visualization tools to manage, query, and analyze datasets to answer specific questions related to the management and monitoring of our natural resources. My background is in oceanography, but my interests are far ranging, and I enjoy acquiring new skills and learning new fields. Outside the office you can find me outside - hiking, paddling, playing sports, or camping.

company.name: National Center for Ecological Analysis and Synthesis (NCEAS)

positions.title: Projects Data Coordinator
positions.description: Coordinates data needs for a synthesis science project examining Alaskan salmon. This includes communicating with scientists to determine data needs, requesting data from outside entities, preparing data for analysis, documenting data with structured metadata, and archiving data on public repositories. Additional tasks include managing and training 5-8 part time student interns to assist in data collation efforts, coordinating and conducting outside training events on reproducible science techniques, and coordinating customer support efforts for the Arctic Data Center archive.

positions.title: Oceanographer
positions.description: Plans and implements oceanographic surveys and field operations. Processes, analyzes, and interprets oceanographic data with the purpose of examining the relationship between oceanographic processes and coral reef ecosystem dynamics. Develops graphical and other synthesized data products for presentation in reports, scientific articles, and outreach/educational materials. Designs and develops software tools and data management procedures to analyze, integrate, and visualize ecosystem data. Develops, implements, and maintains procedures to process and produce data products for current and historical data. Contributes to scientific manuscripts for publication and presents research at various conferences or relevant settings. Participates in research cruises, marine ecosystem surveys and observation networks to assess and monitor coral reefs, which involves field surveys, the deployment and recovery oceanographic instrument platforms, and data transmission, analysis, and creation of data products. Provides training and guidance in operating equipment, conducting field surveys and processing data.

positions.title: Oceanographic Specialist
positions.description: Assists in deploying and recovering scientific instruments for various near-shore and coastal physical oceanographic experiments around the Hawaiian Islands. Analyzes and manages data from these experiments. Writes results, both internally and for peer-reviewed scientific journals.
